The core is a bicyclic system with a double bond. Diels-Alder would break a six-membered ring into diene and dienophile.

We need to search template catalog for Diels-Alder retrosynthesis. Use functional_groups_broken maybe "C-C double bonds" and "C-C double bonds" broken? Also bonds formed: 6-6 (new sigma bonds). Bonds broken: 6-6 (the sigma bond of the cyclohexene? Actually Diels-Alder forms two new sigma bonds between the diene and dienophile, breaking the pi bonds. So bonds order changed: C=C to C-C (order change). So we can specify bonds_order_changed: "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"? Not sure.
